global_gotchas.text: Create by name may return obsolete components. Always use GUID.
Many components share names (Sphere, Box, Integer). Check category or use GUID.
Sliders have no Params property. They act as simple output sources.
Three data types: single (1 path, 1 item), list (1 path, N items), tree (N paths). Use gh_inspect_output to check.
Graft adds branch level (list→tree). Flatten removes ALL branches (tree→list). Not perfect inverses.
